name: Breadcrumbs
summary: The path from the top of a hierarchy to the current page, for apps deep enough that people need to know where they are and go back up (files, settings, documentation). Not for steps in a process (use a stepper) or for a flat app's sections (use Navigation or Tabs).
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG breadcrumb: a `nav` landmark named "Breadcrumb" around an ordered list, so its length and each step's position are read. Each page above is a Link; the current page is plain text with `aria-current="page"`, never a link to itself. Separators are decorative icons that mirror in right-to-left. A collapsed path is one quiet icon-only button named with the number of hidden pages; pressing it shows them in place and moves focus to the first one. Steps wrap as whole units onto lines at least a minimum target apart; one long name wraps inside itself.

keys.action: moves through the links, then past the current page
shows the hidden pages and focuses the first

props.name: items
props.description: The path from the top, ending with the current page.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Longest path shown in full. Past it, the first page and the last `maxItems - 2` stay and the ones between collapse into one "Show n more pages in the path" button that reveals them in place. Leave out to always show the whole path.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep one line and ellipsize the current page when space is short. Its full name remains accessible and is available on hover. Default false: steps and names wrap.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark's name; "Breadcrumb" unless a page has two.

props.name: label
props.description: The page's name as it appears in its own title.

props.name: href
props.description: Where it is. Ignored on the last item: the current page is never a link.
